issues.label: Statutory ground (c)(i) established by evidence
issues.why: Court must determine whether clear and convincing evidence supports the 182-day/conditions-continue-to-exist ground actually relied upon.

issues.label: Reasonable efforts at reunification
issues.why: DHHS must generally make reasonable efforts to reunify before termination, the central issue presented for review.

issues.label: Adequacy of SUD treatment referrals
issues.why: Whether the referrals to Recovery Pathways and Wellspring constituted reasonable accommodation given the inpatient recommendation.

issues.label: Failure to provide recommended inpatient treatment
issues.why: The psychological evaluation recommended inpatient drug treatment, yet only outpatient referrals were made.

issues.label: Timing/delay of psychological evaluation
issues.why: The delayed assessment may bear on whether efforts were reasonable and timely.

issues.label: Respondent's obligation to participate/benefit
issues.why: Reasonable efforts require respondent's own participation, which the record shows was inconsistent.

issues.label: Best interests of the children
issues.why: Court must separately find termination serves each child's best interests.

issues.label: Best interests with relative/parent placement
issues.why: The oldest child's placement with her biological father is a factor weighing against termination that must be explicitly considered.

issues.label: Separate analysis for each child
issues.why: The two children have different placements and circumstances requiring individualized findings.

issues.label: Indian Child Welfare Act applicability
issues.why: ICWA removed the middle child, raising whether the remaining children are also Indian children triggering heightened standards.

issues.label: Adequacy of no-contest plea and factual basis
issues.why: Court must ensure the plea establishing jurisdiction was knowing, voluntary, and factually supported.

issues.label: Contrary-to-welfare and removal findings
issues.why: Court must verify proper preliminary findings justifying removal were made.

issues.label: Sufficiency of trial court's findings/reasoning
issues.why: Court cited only (c) without specifying subsection, requiring adequate factual findings for appellate review.

issues.label: Housing stability determination
issues.why: The disputed lease enforceability affects whether the barrier condition truly persisted.

issues.label: Income/employment as termination basis
issues.why: Reliance on lack of legal income beyond government assistance raises poverty-versus-neglect concerns.

issues.label: Benefit-from-services determination
issues.why: Whether completing parenting classes without demonstrated benefit supports the persistence of conditions.

issues.label: Reasonable likelihood of rectification within reasonable time
issues.why: Subsection (c)(i) requires finding no reasonable likelihood conditions will be rectified given the children's ages.

issues.label: Standard of review and burden of proof
issues.why: Court must apply clear-and-convincing standard for grounds and clear-error review on appeal.
